title: cleistanthus boivinianus
intro: Cleistanthus boivinianus, commonly known as the "Indian Spider Plant" or "Kalmegh", is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. It has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, as well as its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleistanthus boivinianus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. These constituents may also possess hepatoprotective, antiviral, and anticancer properties, although more research is needed to confirm their efficacy in these areas.
